sort: Drag each part of the Earth to its description (Land: brown and green areas where we live, about 1/3 of earth | Water: blue areas (oceans, seas, rivers), about 2/3 of earth | Equator: imaginary line around the middle of earth | North Pole: top point of earth | South Pole: bottom point of earth | Axis: imaginary line earth spins on)
identify: How much of the Earth is covered by water? (About two-thirds (2/3) vs About half (1/2) vs Almost all (9/10))

sort: Drag each fact about Earth's size to True or False (True: earth is very large, it takes days to travel around it, millions of people live on earth | False: earth is as small as a football, you can walk around earth in a day, earth is smaller than the moon)

sort: Drag each use of a globe to its correct purpose (Globe shows: continents and oceans, true shape of countries, equator and poles, day and night areas | Globe cannot: show small streets, be folded in a bag, show weather forecast)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Globe — a globe is a small round 3D model of the Earth. It shows the true shape of the Earth and the correct sizes and shapes of continents, oceans, and countries. It has an axis (tilted stick) that it spins on. It shows the equator (imaginary line around the middle). Advantages: true shape, accurate sizes. Disadvantages: cannot show small details, cannot be folded, expensive. (2) Earth shape and size — Earth is round like a ball (sphere), not flat. It is called the 'blue planet' because 2/3 (about 71%) is covered with water. Land is about 1/3 (29%). Earth is very large — about 12,742 km across. It takes many hours to fly around it. Millions of people, animals, and plants live on Earth. Earth has: continents (large land masses), oceans (huge water bodies), equator (middle line), north pole (top), south pole (bottom), axis (imaginary spin line). Earth spins on its axis causing day and night. Misconceptions: 'earth is flat' (earth is round like a ball — photos from space prove this), 'earth is mostly land' (earth is 2/3 water — that's why it's called the blue planet), 'globe and map are the same' (globe is 3D and round, map is 2D and flat — globe shows true shapes, map can be folded), 'you can see the whole earth from your window' (earth is huge — you can only see a tiny part from anywhere on the ground), 'equator is a real line you can see' (equator is imaginary — it's drawn on globes and maps but not visible on earth). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function GlobeGame), NOT export default. Export interface GlobeGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
